item.title: Zuckerberg's metaverse dream is collapsing after billions in losses
item.description: Reality Labs encompasses several areas of Meta's VR/AR business, but Bloomberg writes that two of them will be hit hardest: Horizon Worlds and virtual reality. Zuckerberg is planning to slash Reality Labs' budget by 30%, with the cuts coming as early as January 2026.Read Entire Article

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admits he doesn't know if AI will eventually destroy humanity
item.description: When asked whether the US winning the AI race against China and other adversaries could be critical for national security, Huang said that nobody really knows how AI will impact our lives or what implications it will have for global geopolitics.Read Entire Article

item.description: The acquisition will further add to Netflix's extensive portfolio of AAA movies and TV shows. item.title: AMD and IBM's CEO doesn't see an AI bubble, just $8 trillion in data centers
item.description: IBM CEO Arvind Krishna argues that AI is not going through a financial bubble, despite many analysts, banks, and investors claiming otherwise. Krishna, who has led the former PC giant since 2020, is more concerned with the unsustainable infrastructure investments planned by OpenAI and other AI ventures seeking AGI paradise.Read Entire Article

item.title: LocalSend is a private and cross-platform alternative to AirDrop
item.description: LocalSend is an open-source app that enables fast, private file transfers between nearby devices without relying on an internet connection. It works across all major operating systems, using a REST API and HTTPS encryption to communicate over your local network.Read Entire Article
